title: Local Marketing Tips Every Business Should Know | Mailchimp

facts.fact: The page says following three steps maximizes the potential of a Google My Business listing.
facts.quote: Follow these three steps to maximize the potential of your Google My Business listing.

facts.fact: The page says that after claiming a business on Google, the verification code typically arrives by postcard, phone call, or email.
facts.quote: Typically, you'll receive a postcard, phone call, or email with a verification code.

facts.fact: The page says there are three ways to develop localized landing pages.
facts.quote: Here are three ways to develop local landing pages:

facts.fact: The page states that long-tail keywords often have a lower overall search volume but typically indicate strong user intent.
facts.quote: While they often have a lower search volume overall, they can be highly valuable since they typically indicate strong user intent.

facts.fact: Consistent NAP (name, address, phone) data is one of the factors that can help a business appear in the local pack search result feature, according to Mailchimp.
facts.quote: Consistent NAP data is one of the factors that can help your business appear in the local pack search result feature.

facts.fact: The local pack is a search result feature that showcases local businesses at the top of the search results page.
facts.quote: This feature showcases local businesses at the top of the search results page, making it easier for new customers to find your business.

facts.fact: Businesses offering incentives such as discounts or freebies for reviews should ensure the practice complies with the terms and policies of the review platforms.
facts.quote: Although this can be an effective local marketing strategy, be cautious and ensure it complies with the terms and policies of the review platforms.

facts.fact: Reviews on a Google My Business (GMB) profile are described as especially influential, playing a role in local search ranking and business visibility.
facts.quote: Reviews on your GMB profile are especially influential. Direct customers to leave reviews on this platform because it plays a role in your local search ranking

facts.fact: Geotagging images with location data is described as an effective local SEO strategy that also improves user experience.
facts.quote: geotagging images with location data. This helps with local SEO and improves the user experience.

facts.fact: Mailchimp states that a mobile-optimized website can lead to lower bounce rates because users are more inclined to stay and interact with content.
facts.quote: A mobile-optimized website can also lead to lower bounce rates, as users are more inclined to stay and interact with your content.
